create_ecs_gateway: create an ECSGateway instance with a region and optional AWS credentials to interact with ECS
extract_log_group_name: extract the CloudWatch log group name from an ECS container definition ID using the gateway
describe_ecs_task_definition: describe an ECS task definition by ARN using the gateway's boto3 ECS client
review_ECSGateway: review the ECSGateway class and its extract_log_group_name method for correctness
refactor_ECSGateway_extract_log_group_na: refactor extract_log_group_name to handle missing task definitions or add error handling
